```{python}
#| label: fig-sim-decision
#| echo: false
#| fig-cap: "Choosing an analysis. The first question is whether a large periodic signal (LO, clock, carrier, or the oscillation itself) sets the operating point, the second is how sharp the resulting waveforms are. Transient (noise) simulation remains the reference that every other analysis should be cross-checked against."
import schemdraw as sd
from schemdraw import flow

sd.svgconfig.svg2 = False

blue = '#dbe8f6'
orange = '#fde3c8'

with sd.Drawing(canvas='svg') as d:
    d.config(fontsize=12, unit=1, margin=0.3)

    q1 = flow.Decision(w=6.4, h=2.4).at((9, 0)).anchor('center') \
        .label('large periodic signal?\n(LO, clock, carrier,\noscillation)')

    q2 = flow.Decision(w=4.6, h=2.0).at((3.5, -3.6)).anchor('center') \
        .label('small signal\naround dc?')
    q3 = flow.Decision(w=5.4, h=2.4).at((14.5, -3.6)).anchor('center') \
        .label('sharp edges or\nstrongly nonlinear?')

    a1 = flow.Box(w=3.8, h=1.6).at((1.2, -7.2)).anchor('center').fill(blue) \
        .label('op, then\nac, acsp, noise')
    a2 = flow.Box(w=3.2, h=1.6).at((5.8, -7.2)).anchor('center').fill(blue) \
        .label('tran')
    a3 = flow.Box(w=3.8, h=1.6).at((11.8, -7.2)).anchor('center').fill(orange) \
        .label('PSS, then\nPAC, PNOISE')
    a4 = flow.Box(w=3.8, h=1.6).at((17.2, -7.2)).anchor('center').fill(orange) \
        .label('HB, then\nHBAC, HBNOISE')

    # q1 branches
    flow.Wire('-|', arrow='->').at(q1.W).to(q2.N).label('no', loc='start', ofst=(-0.2, 0.25))
    flow.Wire('-|', arrow='->').at(q1.E).to(q3.N).label('yes', loc='start', ofst=(0.2, 0.25))
    # q2 branches
    flow.Wire('-|', arrow='->').at(q2.W).to(a1.N).label('yes', loc='start', ofst=(-0.2, 0.25))
    flow.Wire('-|', arrow='->').at(q2.E).to(a2.N).label('no', loc='start', ofst=(0.2, 0.25))
    # q3 branches
    flow.Wire('-|', arrow='->').at(q3.W).to(a3.N).label('yes', loc='start', ofst=(-0.2, 0.25))
    flow.Wire('-|', arrow='->').at(q3.E).to(a4.N).label('no', loc='start', ofst=(0.2, 0.25))

    # hints below the result boxes
    sd.elements.Label().at((11.8, -8.4)).label('single fundamental,\nswitching circuits,\noscillators',
                                                fontsize=10, color='gray', valign='top')
    sd.elements.Label().at((17.2, -8.4)).label('mildly nonlinear,\nseveral tones,\nS-parameter models',
                                                fontsize=10, color='gray', valign='top')
    sd.elements.Label().at((1.2, -8.4)).label('amplifiers, filters,\nmatching, LNA noise',
                                               fontsize=10, color='gray', valign='top')
    sd.elements.Label().at((5.8, -8.4)).label('large signal, start-up,\nsettling, non-periodic',
                                               fontsize=10, color='gray', valign='top')

    # transient noise as the general fallback and cross-check
    flow.Box(w=16.6, h=1.3).at((9.1, -11.4)).anchor('center').fill('#eeeeee') \
        .label('noise that is not small (decisions, metastability, jitter), or a cross-check: transient noise')
```
